tools.name: get_month
tools.description: List the most notable items for a given year and month (optionally one genre), across countries, e.g. year=1985, month=8. Use this to answer 'what happened / what came out in <month> <year>'.

tools.name: on_this_day
tools.description: List notable things that happened or were released on a given calendar day (month and day) in different years, from 1970 onward.

tools.name: person_timeline
tools.description: Chronological list of works and events linked to a person (singer, director, actor, author, developer...). Japanese or English names.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Given a Wikidata ID (e.g. Q332368), return the release/occurrence dates in each country known to ChronoDrawer, with links. Answers questions like 'when was this film released in Japan?'.

tools.name: report_correction
tools.description: Report a factual error or missing information in ChronoDrawer (e.g. a wrong date). A human reviews it before anything changes. Include the item title, what is wrong, and a source.
